params.body:
## What

The gate reads a topic id with its name glued on as that id: `topic-10-media-platforms` becomes `topic-10`. It does so only when the name after the id does not point at another topic: `topic-10-fashion-style` stays dropped, because it is ambiguous.

## Why

The first audit of the gate on the box (7 days) dropped 31 concept topics. The five most frequent were all of this form: `topic-10-media-platforms`, `topic-14-technology-ai`, `topic-05-fashion-style`, `topic-11-social-relationships`, `topic-07-mental-health`. In each, the id is right there. Dropping them threw away a correct tag; now the audit counts them as corrected.

## Tests

One new case in `test/conform.test.mjs`. Full suite: 1131 pass, 6 fail. The 6 are the report-render tests, which need `pdftoppm`; the workbench lacks it and the box has it.
params.title: The gate reads topic-NN-name as topic-NN
